name: Real PII MUST NEVER be used in Non-Prod/Test environments; synthetic or anonymised data MUST be used instead because anonymisation scripts are unreliable and real data causes major data breaches.
requirementTitle: Real PII MUST NEVER be used in Non-Prod/Test environments; synthetic or anonymised data MUST be used instead because anonymisation scripts are unreliable and real data causes major data breaches.
requirementDescription: You must not copy real personal data into development, test, UAT, or training environments. Instead, use fake (synthetic) data or properly anonymised data
why: Production environments have strict access controls, monitoring, security reviews and limited admin access, but test environments have wider access, temporary configurations so having PII in these environments creates unneccessary risk
